question: WHY DO PILOTS
DUMP TONS OF FUEL?
options: To mark their position for rescuers
To be light enough to land safely
answer_full: To be light enough to land safely
recap: A jumbo jet turning back right after takeoff, spraying fuel from both wings.
explain: A big jet may take off heavier than it is allowed to land.
Landing gear and airframe can't absorb a touchdown with full tanks, so the crew gets rid of weight.
At altitude, the fuel breaks into tiny droplets and evaporates before it reaches the ground.
